context_content_data.rationale: The candidate immediately addresses the prompt by explaining their future plans after the HSC exam (vacation and university preparation).
context_content_data.evidence: Now I'll tell you what I'll do after passing exams. I'm thinking of going on a vacation after the exam ends. Then I'll start prep study for university.

structure_format_brevity.rationale: All six standard structural components of an informal letter are correctly present in their proper positions, along with an envelope format.
structure_format_brevity.evidence:
Jatrabari, Dhaka
27/06/2026

Dear Shiba,
...
Yours ever
Kuddus.

language_mechanics.rationale: The script contains several spelling, capitalization, and grammatical errors ('family is', mid-sentence 'If', 'regred', 'SO', 'tody') which preclude awarding the mark for mechanics.
language_mechanics.evidence: I think If you don't use this time properly you will regred in future. SO use your time wisely. NO more tody.

originality_comparisons_paraphrase.rationale: The expression is authentic and logically sequenced with natural conversational flow, avoiding heavily memorized template clichés in the core message.
originality_comparisons_paraphrase.evidence: I'm thinking of going on a vacation after the exam ends. Then I'll start prep study for university.

frequent_errors: Spelling errors ('regred' instead of 'regret', 'tody' instead of 'today')
Subject-verb agreement slip ('you and your family is')
positive_aspects: Complete adherence to informal letter layout with all 6 required parts present
Immediate and clear communication of post-exam future plans

feedback_summary: The candidate delivers a well-structured informal letter meeting all layout requirements (address, date, salutation, body, close, signature, and envelope). The topic is addressed directly with clear, authentic ideas about future plans. While the communication is effective, multiple mechanical and spelling inaccuracies place the script at the lower end of Band 4 (4 out of 5).
